in_marathi.name: Bapuji
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Father of all, God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bapuji हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bapuji is a Sanskrit term that translates to 'Father of all' or 'God'. This name is often used as a title of reverence for respected spiritual leaders or deities in Hinduism.
